Serena Williams stands center court, arms extended high as she holds the gleaming 2013 China Open trophy above her head. The ornate gold cup features detailed floral engravings and two decorative handles, with a plaque inscribed “Women's Singles Champion.” Her joyful expression and the stadium lights in the background underscore the triumph of her 11–1 record at this event.

This photograph appears in an article ranking Serena Williams’ top five tournaments by win percentage. It highlights her dominant 91% win rate at the China Open, the highest of her career, and situates this victory among her successes at the Australian Open, Wimbledon, US Open, and Miami Open.

Image URL: https://legacymedia.sportsplatform.io/images_root/slides/photos/000/942/940/114194810_original.jpg?w=3840# Sharapova’s Italian Open Triumph

Maria Sharapova clinched the 2011 Internazionali BNL d’Italia women’s singles title at the Foro Italico in Rome on May 15, 2011. After Azarenka retired in the quarterfinals and Sharapova defeated Caroline Wozniacki in the semifinals, she faced Samantha Stosur in the final. Sharapova dominated the match, securing her first clay‑court title of the season and leaving the French Open as the only Grand Slam missing from her career achievements.

The silver trophy, engraved with “CAMPIONATI INTERNAZIONALI D’ITALIA FEMMINILI COPPA FEDERAZIONE ITALIANA TENNIS,” reflects the prestige of the event. Sharapova’s victory propelled her to the top of the women’s power rankings and underscored her adaptability on clay, setting the stage for her bid at Roland Garros.
